title: OrgUpdated
description: An organization's details changed. Only what changed is sent, besides `org_id` and `updated_at`: a role switch sends `kind` and `account_type`; the organization screen any of `name`, `legal_name`, `inn`, `contact_phone`, `address`.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

updated_at.description: When the change was made. ISO 8601 with offset, as Python's `isoformat()` writes it.
